items.title: Danny Barker Interview, 1959-06-18
items.q: Let me read that. Freddie Leonia.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. Old Lady Morris. Let me read that. Freddie Leonia. That's L-E-O-N-N-I. Small. God's messenger, barer, and healer. Who is scattering the spirits, picayune, to be happen and to behold. This man has told and cured various things. He is past understanding. Heals with prayers and herbs. Moreover, he is even the harmonica genius. If you desire to see him, you may. Hours for clients, 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Thursday through Saturday. 823 North Robinson Street. Rural Apartment 3. New Orleans, Louisiana. City Park and…
